title: NOVEL.toml
description: Book-level metadata and module declarations for a novel-spec v0.1 repository.

spec_version.description: novel-spec version this repo conforms to.

genre.description: Free-form genre label; informs which modules apply. e.g. scifi, webnovel, mystery, literary.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the prose language, e.g. zh, en, ja.

modules.description: Optional type-specific modules to enable. Known keys: webnovel, scifi, mystery. Unknown keys are tolerated (forward-compat).
